text:
[Council File 22-0623]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to a request for approval to submit the City's Prohousing Designation application to the State of California (State) Department of Housing and Community Development (HCD).
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. APPROVE the proposed application category items, as recommended by the General Manager, Housing Department (LAHD), on behalf of the City of Los Angeles.
2. ADOPT the accompanying Formal RESOLUTION, Attachment A of the LAHD report dated October 8, 2026, as required by the State for applicants, in order to submit the final application for the Prohousing Designation Program.
3. AUTHORIZE the General Manager, LAHD, or designee, to:
a. Sign on behalf of the City of Los Angeles as an applicant, as determined by the Prohousing Designation Program, as per the accompanying Formal RESOLUTION.
b. Lead the coordination, partnership and engagement in the development of the required application materials for the Prohousing Designation Program Application.
c. Accept the Prohousing Designation, if granted.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The LAHD reports that there is no impact to the General Fund. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
